Crystal Shapeshifters
​
Introduction
Crystal Shapeshifters  are a slayer monster found on Tarddiad and are accessible via the World Gate (looks like the number 1), they can be assigned by Morvran or Laniakea after the completion of The Light Within quest. Crystal Shapeshifters will change their attacking style to what your armour is weakest against (if this is equal, attack styles will be random).
​
Stats
⬥  level: 80

Useful Items and Unlocks


















Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory

Items
⬥ Slayer Codex

⬥ Sixth-Age circuit 
    • Used to teleport to the World Gate if doing the Tarddiad method
⬥ Each piece of crystal armour  worn increases the drop rate of the Ancient elven wedding ring
    • Attuned crystal armour boosts this drop rate massively
